item.title: Product Hunt Daily | 2026-07-30
item.description:
1. Prelint

Tagline: Prevent product drift in AI-written code
Description: AI writes your code at 10× speed. Prelint makes sure it’s the right code - it reviews every PR against your ADRs, docs and past decisions, and catches product drift before it ships. On teams using several AI reviewers, ~40% of the issues fixed before merge are caught by Prelint.
Website: open
Product Hunt: View on Product Hunt

Keyword: AI code review, product drift prevention, ADR compliance, automated code quality, DevOps integration, pre-merge validation, AI assistant oversight, technical debt reduction, team collaboration, code consistency

Tagline: AI Music Tutor that gives real-time feedback on your playing
Description: SoundGate Guitar is an AI practice companion that actually listens to you play. Get instant visual feedback on an interactive fretboard with zero-lag note detection. The built-in AI tutor analyzes your playing to provide personalized feedback, custom practice routines, and answers to any guitar question.

Tagline: Turn your vibe-coded app into paying customers
Description: You vibe-coded your app. Now what? 🤔 AI makes building easy, but getting customers is the hard part. Denovo takes you straight from idea to revenue. 💸 Get a ready-to-convert website with Stripe pre-wired, plus an automated growth engine sending emails to 100M leads and setting up your Meta ads campaigns. 🚀 Just ask “how’s business?” for your revenue and next steps. 15,000+ businesses built here. Yours is one line away.

5. ClinicFrame

Tagline: Like Granola, but for healthcare. Fully HIPAA-compliant.
Description: An ambient AI scribe that writes clinical notes in real time so you can focus on your patient. It passively captures every visit, whether in person or virtual, and delivers a complete, structured clinical note the moment the encounter ends. HIPAA compliant, desktop native, and EHR ready in seconds. We’re launching Scribe today, with a much bigger vision ahead: a medical intelligence platform that goes beyond documentation to support the entire clinical workflow.

6. MemoryCustodian

Tagline: Repo-native memory for coding agents
Description: MemoryCustodian gives Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, and other coding agents durable project memory—without a hosted service or bloating every prompt. Decisions, constraints, rejected approaches, and project context live as plain Markdown in your repo, where they can be reviewed, versioned, shared, and deleted like code. A manifest loads only the memory relevant to each task. Open source, local-first, and cross-agent.

Tagline: Run coding agents through the full development process
Description: Task Monki is an open-source desktop app for managing coding agents from task to pull request. Run several tasks at once, follow each agent’s progress, preview every result without manually setting up services or containers, send work to another agent for review and fixes, and bring multiple agents into the same discussion, where they can respond to each other, compare approaches, and challenge assumptions.

10. Vela

Tagline: The AI Recruiting Coordinator
Description: Vela is an AI recruiting coordinator. Cc it on any email thread and it takes over: candidate screens, multi-round loops, and full panels. It offers times, chases people who go quiet, handles reschedules, sends the resume with the invite, books prep calls, and collects feedback. Email, SMS, WhatsApp, Slack, and phone, every time zone, 24/7. No links, no logins, nothing new for your team to learn. Trusted by The World’s Best Recruiters, and backed by YC, CRV, and other incredible investors.
